params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$r='C:\Users\Xxkan\mhw-mods-work-canonical'
$b='agent/swarm-contract-v3-20260929-0540'
$expected='df74b159fda02723dd85a74a4b75b5de47b8b631'
git -C $r fetch origin --prune | Out-Null
$line=@(git -C $r ls-remote --heads origin ('refs/heads/'+$b))
if(!$line.Count){[pscustomobject]@{branch=$b;state='already-absent'}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress;exit 0}
$actual=($line[0] -split '\s+')[0]
if($actual -ne $expected){throw ('tip changed: '+$actual)}
$mainText=git -C $r show 'origin/main:tools/agent-control/lib/prompt-templates.mjs'
$need=@('main is the canonical integration target','This exact assignment does not include repository-write authorization for heaven','Preserve the permanent recursive continuity constitution and require successors to propagate it again')
foreach($n in $need){if(($mainText -join "`n") -notlike ('*'+$n+'*')){throw ('semantic proof missing: '+$n)}}
git -C $r push origin (':refs/heads/'+$b) | Out-Null
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw 'delete failed'}
[pscustomobject]@{branch=$b;deleted=$true;proof='all three patch-unique prompt rules present on current origin/main';main=(git -C $r rev-parse origin/main).Trim()}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress
